capture_register.calibration_rule_verbatim: A rule or scale lying in the same plane as the surface being measured, in shot, in focus, at the same distance from the lens as that surface. A ruler beside the bottle rather than in its plane does not calibrate anything.

calibration_assessment.IMG_3341: COMPLIANT for the front silhouette — the ruler stands in the bottle's axis plane, and a cylinder's silhouette tangent points lie in the axis plane
calibration_assessment.IMG_3344: NON_COMPLIANT — both rulers lie flat in the table plane while the bottle axis sits ~18.7 mm and the dropper axis ~11 mm above it; every 3344 quantity carries a depth correction
calibration_assessment.IMG_3338: COMPLIANT for the closure top face; the circularity result taken from it is calibration-free regardless

circularity.method: second-moment ellipse fit — covariance eigenvalues of the filled mask; calibration-free, immune to cross-frame scale error
circularity.finding: 0.96% out of round; two frames at ~47 deg different major-axis orientations agree
circularity.residual_caveat: camera tilt could in principle cancel real ovality; the differing major-axis orientations weaken but do not eliminate this
circularity.discharges: the owner's conditional side-view ruling — no asymmetry found
